verdict.rationale: The Agent SDK (programmable in Python, same agent loop/tools) and Scheduled Tasks with cron-based autonomous background execution both point toward headless/automation use, and the CLI is terminal-based which is amenable to scripting. However, there's no explicit documentation of a non-interactive/CI mode, no CI/CD integration examples (GitHub Actions, Docker, etc.), and no independent/hands-on confirmation that it runs reliably headlessly. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, confirmation of non-interactive flag/mode, independent verification of headless runs.
